stem.text: The graph compares the effect of temperature on the activity of the protease enzyme, papain, when in solution (free) and when immobilised in alginate beads.

stem.alt: Graph of activity of papain against temperature in degrees Celsius, with two curves labelled immobilised papain and free papain.

stem.text: Which statement about the effect of immobilisation of papain is correct?

A.text: It alters the shape of papain's active site at higher temperatures.

B.text: It decreases the activity of papain at higher temperatures.

C.text: It increases the stability of papain at higher temperatures.

D.text: It reduces the number of collisions of papain with the substrate.
